children.name: xl_form_width
children.label: XL Form Width
children.help_text: Controls the form width on extra large screens (1200px and above). The content column will automatically fill the remaining space.

children.name: lg_form_width
children.label: LG Form Width
children.help_text: Controls the form width on large screens (992px - 1199px). Select 'Inherit' to use the XL Form Width setting, or choose a specific width. The content column will automatically fill the remaining space.

children.name: tablet_form_width
children.label: MD Form Width
children.help_text: Controls the form width on medium/tablet screens (768px - 991px). Select 'Inherit' to use the LG Form Width setting (or XL if LG is also set to inherit), or choose a specific width. The content column will automatically fill the remaining space.
